finalText:
Build's green now (exit 0). There were two real bugs hiding behind the deprecation-warning noise, both from the bundler's options shape changing:

1. `src/core/options.js` — `resolveRetries` still read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now hands `{ retryCount }`. Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — `isBackoffEnabled` strictly required `true`/`false` and threw on anything else, but the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`. Fixed to treat `undefined` as `false`.

The remaining 8 warnings are just deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()` constructor, punycode, etc.) — not blocking the build, but worth cleaning up eventually if you want to silence them too.
